title: Pasta vongole with whiting
description: A classic from the Italian coastal cuisine with a North Sea twist. Vongole, whiting, and a touch of chili provide a light pasta full of flavor. Ideal for those who love pure ingredients and fish as the main feature.

instructions.text: Rinse the vongole thoroughly under cold water and remove damaged or open ones that do not close when tapped.
Cook the spaghetti according to the instructions on the package.
Finely chop the shallot and cut the chili pepper into thin rings. Toast the flaked almonds in a dry frying pan until golden brown, then let cool.
Heat a generous splash of olive oil in a pan and sauté the shallot, chili pepper, and pressed garlic. Add the vongole and season with a pinch of turmeric, pepper, and salt.
Deglaze with the white wine, cover the pan, and let the vongole open over high heat.
Add the cooked spaghetti and mix well with the vongole.
Meanwhile, season the whiting fillets with pepper and salt. Fry them in a splash of olive oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Divide the pasta among the plates. Place a whiting fillet on each and finish with the toasted flaked almonds and coriander, and serve immediately.
